reply.text:
Yes, you can. Sleeves are an accessory, not a requirement: they hold warmth and give a bit of feel at the bottom, but the squat itself doesn't depend on them. Warm up a touch longer, keep your first few sets lighter than usual, and see how the working weight feels. If you want a replacement, any snug neoprene sleeve will do the same job.

If your knees hurt when you squat, or that's why you wear them, that's one for a doctor or physio rather than me, and I'll train around whatever they clear.
